name: InputSharedWidgetMessageContent

fields.name: widget_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget created by the bot

fields.name: chat_data
fields.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Mode for parsing entities in the widget caption. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: caption_entities
fields.description: List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

fields.name: show_caption_above_media
fields.description: Pass True if the caption must be shown above the widget

description: Represents the content of a message with a shared widget to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
